newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Telecom shares slide 1.31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Telecom shares slide 1.31 pct.

text.p: Shares in Pakistan Telecommunications Co Ltd (PTCL) on Wednesday dipped 0.45 rupees, or 1.31 percent, to 33.90 on fears that its convertible debt issue could limit share price gains, dealers said.
Turnover of 8.8 million PTCL shares was recorded at the Karachi bourse by midsession.
"PTCL weakend because local investors see that it would limit PTCL upside after the fixation of its conversion rate from bonds into shares," dealer Sajad Mankani of BMA Capital Management said.
Dealer Ather Raouf said some foreign investors sold PTCL global depositary receipts to purchase PTCL bonds.
Nomura International had said earlier on Wednesday that the $150 million five-year convertible bond issue was "comfortably over-subscribed."
The books had been opened on Monday after last week's roadshows and were expected to close later on Wednesday.
